notes: Setting who approves whose leave is no longer the Backend account's job alone. A Super Admin can now grant it to an HR Manager — tick “Leave approval hierarchy” on their account in Permissions — and that HR then gets the “Who approves whose leave” screen from Leave. It is a per-account permission rather than something every HR gets: arranging reporting lines is ordinary HR work, but rewiring an approval ladder decides whose yes counts on a request. Without the grant the screen says so instead of appearing and then refusing to save. The usual limits still apply — nobody sets their own approvers, and another company’s staff stay out of reach. Also in this build, from 2.8.0: people who have left no longer appear in any picker or on the org chart (their team moves up to the nearest manager still here); HR Managers see and manage every employee in their own company rather than only the ones assigned to them, and can set an employee’s HR partner and reporting manager themselves; and how many late arrivals are free each month is now a setting a Super Admin controls, no longer reduced for somebody who joined part-way through the month — everyone gets the whole allowance every month, including their first.
